label: 📊 Google Sheets
description: Reverse-ETL write to a Google Sheets spreadsheet. URI is sheets://<spreadsheet-id>?credentials=<service-account-json>. Requires `gspread` and a service-account JSON with editor access to the spreadsheet.

sheet.label: Worksheet name
sheet.help: The tab name within the spreadsheet. Created if missing (when 'mode' is 'overwrite' or 'clear_first').

mode.label: Write mode
mode.help: 'append' adds rows after the last; 'overwrite' replaces from row 1 (keeping any rows past the new data); 'clear_first' wipes the sheet then writes.
